text:
Evan: CloudHarbor needs a partner co-sell runbook + sandbox by Tue AM. Must include provisioning steps, entitlement matrix, SSO checklist, outbound IPs, and a simple Hosted vs Dedicated cost note.
cloudharbor-eng: Prefer ephemeral embed tokens for dev and a Hosted-like sandbox. Also want a quick decision on whether Dedicated burst is possible for latency tests.
Priya: High level: we can provision a shared sandbox (Hosted-mode) with scoped dev keys and short-lived tokens. Dedicated burst possible for 1 week but needs finance approval.
Noah: Network: if they use an on-prem connector we need their firewall to whitelist our NAT IPs. I'll allocate NAT and post IPs once provisioned.
security: Security: we cannot issue prod keys. KMS/HSM is only in Private; we'll note that in the questionnaire answers. Need completed security questionnaire before any data-sharing.
Evan: Can we give an example token flow to send them? They want to show it to their infra team.
Priya: Example mint: ``POST /admin/partners/{pid}/tokens`` body ``{"ttl":3600,"scopes":["embed:write","generate:limited"]}``. Tokens expire, are scoped, and audited.
cloudharbor-eng: Also need a short SAML checklist for our IdP team.
Noah: Minimal SAML checklist: EntityID, IdP metadata XML, ACS URL, cert (PEM), NameID format, test user with email claim. If SCIM is needed note: SCIM available for Dedicated only.
security: I'll draft canned responses for the questionnaire and flag SOC2 artifact requests. Will add retention defaults for pilot sandboxes (30 days) and steps to request exceptions.
infra-bot: infra: provisioning sandbox request queued (req=77001). NAT allocation in progress.
Priya: Pricing quick note: Hosted pilot = pilot credits (example: 100k gen tokens + 3k embed units). Dedicated 1xA10-like burst = ~10k/week (incl basic support) as a ballpark. I'll confirm with finance and attach formal quote.
Noah: NAT allocated. Outbound IPs: [54.210.77.10, 54.210.77.11].
Evan: Great. Priya please attach entitlement template and canned security answers to the runbook. Noah will paste NAT IPs here (done). I'll compile and send to CloudHarbor tomorrow AM and request IdP metadata + primary tech contact.
cloudharbor-eng: We'll send metadata + a test account by EOD. Also confirm they can accept the pilot timeline of 3 weeks.
Priya: Uploaded files: partner_entitlement_example_v1.docx and CH_security_answers_v0.9.pdf to shared folder.
security: Remind partner to include any SOC2 evidence requests in their questionnaire reply; we'll route through security for expedited review.
Evan: Plan: send runbook + checklist + pricing ballpark tomorrow AM, enable sandbox once we get security Q completed and IdP metadata. Schedule demo after SAML test is green. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
